name: schedule
description: Manage scheduled jobs: create, list, delete, update. Supports cron schedules, one-shot times, LLM prompts, bash commands, and reminders.

schedule.description: Cron expression (e.g. '0 0 9 * * 1-5') or RFC3339 one-shot time (required for create)

tier.description: LLM tier (haiku, sonnet, opus) or 'direct' for bash commands

message.description: Direct push notification text (no LLM, no command)

user_only.description: List only user-created jobs (not system jobs)
